scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "wait-on -t 120000 tcp:127.0.0.1:3001 && npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
